confirmedReaderGaps.details: Archive members inferred text/plain and displayed as text. Direct application MIME routes to binary inspector; no structured data preview.
May display under explicit text/plain MIME, but no reliable suffix-based entry or specialist reading mode.
No React component preview/transpilation runtime; unknown application MIME is binary info only.
Extracts chosen member and opens basename as standalone file; no site root mount/resource map for sibling CSS/JS/images or multi-page navigation.
Existing DXF/STEP model view is reusable, but there are no corresponding standalone file importers.
Existing STEP/DXF partial rendering does not imply IGES/BREP support.
No layout decoding; generic archive or embedded image access would be a partial preview, not complete document support.
Competitor advertises categories; exact suffix matrices require further evidence. Do not fabricate competitor support for individual extensions.

readerAlreadyPresent: Office/PDF and selected images via WeChat native viewers
recommendedOrder: Unify JSON/XML/CSV and code/config text entry; bounded readable content before claiming structured views.

Investigate JSX/TSX/React runtime and library compatibility separately.
Specialist RAW/iWork/IGES/BREP only after independent producer and fidelity validation.
